name: Neuroimaging
desc: Software for analyzing brain data from living subjects.

resources.name: AFNI
resources.desc: Volumetric viewer from the AFNI suit. GUI's aesthetic defined by the '90s era Motif toolkit.

resources.name: freeview
resources.desc: Surface and volumetric image viewer in Freesurfer suit. Uses the QT toolkit.

resources.name: fsleyes
resources.desc: Volumetric viewer from FSL.

resources.name: mricron
resources.desc: Volumetric viewer that works on windows.

resources.name: dsistudio
resources.desc: DSI viewer from the dsi-studio suit of tools.

resources.name: osirix
resources.desc: DICOM database organizer and viewer.

resources.name: Mango
resources.desc: Multi-image Analysis GUI is a viewer for medical research images for dcm, nii, surface, etc; version 4.1 released in 2019.

resources.name: wb_view
resources.desc: Connectome workbench surface file viewer.

resources.name: reproIn
resources.desc: Naming exam card sequences.

resources.name: BIDS
resources.desc: Brain Imaging Data Structure - directory hierarchy and file naming specification.

resources.name: PACS
resources.desc: Picture Archiving and Communication System standard used to store and transfer DICOM images from medical equipment and likely implemented by scanner manufacture. See Siemens Healthineers Syngo Carbon, Phillips Vue PACS, GE HealthCare True PACS.

resources.name: XNAT
resources.desc: An extensible open-source imaging informatics software platform dedicated to imaging-based research.

resources.name: DAX
resources.desc: Distributed Automation for XNAT: use containerization w/YAML defined input/output.

resources.name: LORIS
resources.desc: Longitudinal Online Research and Imaging System is a web-based data and project management software for neuroimaging research studies.

resources.name: brainlife.io
resources.desc: Open-source, free and secure reproducible neuroscience analysis platform.

resources.name: cbrain
resources.desc: Web-based software that allows neuroimaging researchers to perform computationally intensive analyses on data by connecting them to High-Performance Computing (HPC).

resources.name: FIRMM
resources.desc: Real-time motion monitoring for fMRI, diffusion, and navigated T1/T2 image acquisition.

resources.name: Dimon
resources.desc: Monitor real-time acquisition of DICOM image files with AFNI.

resources.name: MRIQC
resources.desc: Extracts no-reference IQMs (image quality metrics) from structural (T1w and T2w) and functional MRI (magnetic resonance imaging) data.

resources.name: mrQA
resources.desc: Tools for quality assurance in medical imaging datasets, including protocol compliance.

resources.name: bids-validator
resources.desc: Validator for the Brain Imaging Data Structure.

resources.name: AFNI
resources.desc: Analysis of Functional NeuroImages is a leading software suite of C, Python, R programs and shell scripts primarily developed for the analysis and display of multiple MRI modalities.

resources.name: FSL
resources.desc: A comprehensive library of analysis tools for FMRI, MRI and diffusion brain imaging data.

resources.name: SPM
resources.desc: Statistical Parametric Mapping refers to the construction and assessment of spatially extended statistical processes used to test hypotheses about functional imaging data.

resources.name: Qu|Nex
resources.desc: The Quantitative Neuroimaging Environment & Toolbox (QuNex) is an open-source software suite that collectively supports an extensible framework for data organization, preprocessing, quality assurance, and analyses across neuroimaging modalities.

resources.name: fmriprep
resources.desc: Accessible preprocessing pipeline robust to variations in scan acquisition protocols with comprehensive error and output reporting. Input is BIDS dataset.

resources.name: afni_proc.py
resources.desc: Best practice pipelines with pre-configured blocks using AFNI.

resources.name: HALFpipe
resources.desc: User-friendly software that facilitates reproducible analysis of fMRI data.

resources.name: XCP-D
resources.desc: Post-processing and noise regression pipeline picks up right where fMRIprep ends.

resources.name: clpipe
resources.desc: Uses fmriprep for preprocessing fMRI data and implements a variety of additional processing steps important for functional connectivity analyses such as nuisance regression and filtering.

resources.name: fmri_processing_scripts
resources.desc: Legacy pipeline for maximal preprocessing.

resources.name: HCP Pipeline
resources.desc: Pipeline scripts implement the Minimal Preprocessing Pipeline (MPP) described in Glasser et al. 2013.

resources.name: dsi-studio
resources.desc: A tractography software tool that maps brain connections and correlates findings with neuropsychological disorders.

resources.name: qsiprep
resources.desc: Configures pipelines for processing diffusion-weighted MRI (dMRI) data.

resources.name: Freesurfer
resources.desc: An open source neuroimaging toolkit for processing, analyzing, and visualizing human brain MR images.

resources.name: CIVET
resources.desc: An image processing pipeline for fully automated volumetric, corticometric, and morphometric analysis of human brain imaging data.

resources.name: dcm2niix
resources.desc: DICOM to NIfTI converter.

resources.name: heudiconv
resources.desc: A flexible DICOM converter for organizing brain imaging data into structured directory layouts.

resources.name: gdcm
resources.desc: Grassroots DICOM is a C++ library and CLI tool for DICOM medical files.

resources.name: pydicom
resources.desc: Python package and cli tool for inspecting, modifying, and creating DICOM files.

resources.name: dcmdirtab, dcmtab_bids
resources.desc: CLI focused, regular expression based, and iteration friendly BIDS conversion pipeline from lncdtools.

resources.name: pymapVBVD
resources.desc: Reads Siemens .dat 'twix' raw data files. Python port of Philipp Ehses' Matlab tool mapVBVD.

resources.name: med2image
resources.desc: Python CLI tool for generating jpg or png images from DICOM or nifti files.

resources.name: make
resources.desc: follow script recipes defined in Makefile.

resources.name: datalad
resources.desc: Keep code, data, containers under control with git and git-annex. Esp datalad run --input=... --output=....

resources.name: 3dNotes
resources.desc: A program to add, delete and show notes for AFNI datasets.

resources.name: niinote
resources.desc: Add AFNI nifti XML history to header to run and record any command. Part of lncdtools.

resources.name: optibet
resources.desc: Shell script to combine afni and fsl tools for more robust skull stripping in patient populations.

resources.name: 3dSkullStrip
resources.desc: AFNI's skull stripping utility with many parameters.

resources.name: bet
resources.desc: FSL's brain extraction tool.

resources.name: antsBrainExtraction.sh
resources.desc: ANTs version.

resources.name: mri-watershed
resources.desc: Part of the Freesurfer pipeline.

resources.name: ROBEX
resources.desc: Robust Brain Extraction without parameter tweaking.

resources.name: ANTs
resources.desc: Advanced Normalization Tools includes probabilistic tissue segmentation and machine learning methods based on expert labeled data to order to maximize reliability and consistency of multiple modality image segmentation.

resources.name: 3dQwarp
resources.desc: OpenMP parallelized AFNI tool to compute a nonlinearly warped version of source dataset to match a base dataset.

resources.name: flirt, fnirt
resources.desc: Warping software provided by FSL tools.

resources.name: templateflow
resources.desc: A modular, version-controlled resource that allows researchers to use templates "off-the-shelf" and share new ones.

resources.name: MNI152
resources.desc: Unbiased standard magnetic resonance imaging template brain volume for normal population.

resources.name: 3dcalc
resources.desc: Voxel-by-voxel arithmetic on 1D to 4D datasets. From AFNI.

resources.name: fslmaths
resources.desc: Simple but powerful program to allow mathematical manipulation of images. From FSL.

resources.name: fscalc
resources.desc: Freesurfer wrapper of fslmaths.

resources.name: 3dDeconvolve
resources.desc: AFNI - Program to calculate the deconvolution of a measurement 3D+time dataset with a specified input stimulus time series. This program can also perform multiple linear regression using multiple input stimulus time series.

resources.name: FEAT
resources.desc: GUI guided analysis of simple experiment based on general linear modeling. Part of FSL.

resources.name: lcmodel
resources.desc: Implements linear-combination modeling of magnetic resonance spectroscopy data.

resources.name: FSL-MRS
resources.desc: A suite of tools for MR Spectroscopy, including single voxel (SVS), MRS imaging (MRSI), functional MRS (fMRS), diffusion MRS (dwMRS), edited spectroscopy, etc.

resources.name: Osprey
resources.desc: An all-in-one software suite for state-of-the art processing and quantitative analysis of in-vivo magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) data.

resources.name: fooof
resources.desc: Fast, efficient, and physiologically-informed tool to parameterize neural power spectra.

resources.name: hurst
resources.desc: Algorithm to assess intrinsic excitation-inhibition imbalance in MR (Trakoshis et al, eLife, 2020).

resources.name: tat2
resources.desc: Time-averaged T2* wrapper script using AFNI binaries from lncdtools.

resources.name: nipy
resources.desc: Includes nibabel, nipype, and nilearn.

resources.name: oro.nifti
resources.desc: Functions for the input/output and visualization of medical imaging data that follow either the ANALYZE, NIfTI or AFNI formats.

resources.name: imtool3D_td
resources.desc: 3D Image Viewer with ROI tools for Matlab (NIFTI viewer, Manual segmentation).

resources.name: Andy's brain blog
resources.desc: Tutorials and videos about neuroimaging analysis from start to finish in all the major software packages (AFNI, SPM, and FSL).

resources.name: DataLad handbook
resources.desc: Start-to-end use cases of specific applications in neuroimaging using provenance tracking software datalad.

resources.name: Hitchhacker's guide to the brain
resources.desc: Notes from study planning to reporting and data sharing by way of acquisition, processing, analysis, and quality control.

resources.name: Online Neuroimaging Resources
resources.desc: A laundry list of online resources for MRI, fMRI, EEG, MEG.

resources.name: U of A: Neuroimaging Core Documentation
resources.desc: Documentation for approaches used and/or developed by the neuroimaging core at the University of Arizona.

resources.name: neurostars
resources.desc: General neuroimaging discuss form. fmriprep suggested Q&A site.

resources.name: afni discuss
resources.desc: AFNI's discuss instance.

resources.name: brainhack
resources.desc: A mattermoust community of neuroimagers.

resources.name: openneuro
resources.desc: A free and open platform for validating and sharing BIDS-compliant MRI, PET, MEG, EEG, and iEEG data.

resources.name: NDA
resources.desc: National Institute of Mental Health Data Archive (NDA) makes available human subjects data collected from hundreds of research projects across many scientific domains.

resources.name: NITRC
resources.desc: NeuroImaging Tools & Resources Collaboratory library of neuroinformatics software and data.

resources.name: ABCD
resources.desc: Long-term Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development study including 1000s of longitudinal MRI scans.

resources.name: UK Biobank
resources.desc: A large-scale biomedical database and research resource with 500,000 research participants.

resources.name: NCANDA
resources.desc: National Consortium on Alcohol and Neurodevelopment in Adolescence (4000+ MR visits).

resources.name: PNC
resources.desc: A population-based sample of over 9500 individuals from the greater Philadelphia area, ages 8-21 years who received medical care at the CHOP network.

resources.name: ENIGMA
resources.desc: The Enhancing Neuro Imaging Genetics through Meta Analysis Consortium contains 50 working group's imaging and genomics data.
